description: Prompts for defining API contracts, interface boundaries, and integration requirements

prompts.title: Define API Endpoints
prompts.prompt:
Based on our User Flow Document and Data Models, help me define the API endpoints needed for this application.

For each endpoint:
1. Specify the HTTP method and route path
2. Define request parameters, headers, and body schema
3. Detail response format and status codes
4. Identify authentication and authorization requirements
5. Note rate limiting or caching considerations
6. Describe error handling approach
7. Explain how this endpoint supports specific user flows

The goal is to create a comprehensive API contract that can be implemented by the development team with high specificity and minimal ambiguity.
prompts.context: Use after data models and user flows are defined

prompts.title: Define Interface Boundaries
prompts.prompt:
Help me define the clear interface boundaries between different parts of our system:

1. Identify the key components/modules in our architecture
2. Define the specific interfaces and contracts between these components
3. Clarify responsibilities for each component
4. Determine what data passes between components and in what format
5. Establish error handling protocols across boundaries
6. Note any performance considerations at these boundaries

This definition will help ensure clean separation of concerns and maintainable architecture.
prompts.purpose: Establish clear boundaries between system components

prompts.title: Establish API Standards
prompts.prompt:
Help me establish consistent API standards and conventions for our project:

1. URL structure and naming patterns
2. Request and response formatting
3. Error handling and status code usage
4. Pagination approach
5. Filtering and sorting conventions
6. Versioning strategy
7. Authentication token handling
8. Documentation standards

These standards should align with RESTful principles (or GraphQL if applicable) while addressing our specific project needs. The goal is to create consistency across all endpoints for better maintainability and developer experience.
prompts.purpose: Define consistent API conventions and patterns
prompts.context: Use before API implementation to ensure consistency

prompts.title: Define Integration Requirements
prompts.prompt:
For any external systems or third-party services our application needs to integrate with, help me define the integration requirements:

1. Identify each external system we need to connect with
2. Define the purpose and scope of each integration
3. Specify the APIs or interfaces we'll use
4. Document authentication and security requirements
5. Define data transformation needs
6. Establish error handling and retry strategies
7. Identify rate limits or quotas to be aware of
8. Note any compliance or regulatory considerations

This specification will ensure we properly plan for all external dependencies and integration points.
prompts.purpose: Specify requirements for external system integrations
